MATCH (a:Equipment {tag:'C-2-4'}), (b:Equipment {tag:'C-13-1'})
MATCH p = (a)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..50]->(b)
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.tag, n.piping_component_name, n.sheet_id)] AS path
LIMIT 1

MATCH path = (a:Equipment {tag:'C-1-4'})-[:send_to|continues_as*1..50]->(b:Equipment {tag:'C-28-3'})
RETURN a.tag AS from_tag, b.tag AS to_tag, length(path) AS hops
LIMIT 1

MATCH (src)-[:is_located_in]->(:PlantSection {unit_id: '15'})
MATCH path = (src)-[:send_to*1..6]->(dst)
WHERE (dst)-[:is_located_in]->(:PlantSection)
  AND dst.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND dst.unit_id <> '15'
  AND all(n IN relationships(path) WHERE type(n) = 'send_to')
RETURN DISTINCT dst.unit_id AS receiving_unit, dst.tag AS receiving_item_tag

MATCH (src)-[:is_located_in]->(:PlantSection {unit_id: '32'})
MATCH (src)-[:send_to]->(a)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:continues_as]->(b)-[:send_to]->(dst)
WITH src, a, dst
WITH src, COALESCE(dst, a) AS target
MATCH (target)-[:is_located_in]->(ps:PlantSection)
WHERE ps.unit_id <> '32'
RETURN DISTINCT target.tag AS tag, ps.unit_id AS unit_id

MATCH (src {tag:'E-47-2'})-[:send_to|continues_as*1..]->(t)
WHERE t <> src
  AND (t:Equipment OR t:PipingComponent)
  AND t.tag IS NOT NULL
  AND t.unit_id = '47'
RETURN DISTINCT t.tag AS tag;

MATCH (t:Tank {tag:'T-2-1'})-[:send_to|continues_as*1..]->(n)
WHERE (n:Equipment OR n:BallValve OR n:GlobeValve OR n:OperatedValve)
  AND NOT (n:PipeOffPageConnector OR n:SignalOffPageConnector)
  AND (n)-[:is_located_in]->(:PlantSection {unit_id:'2'})
RETURN DISTINCT n.tag AS tag

MATCH p = shortestPath((a {tag:'BV-7-6'})-[:send_to|continues_as*..50]->(b {tag:'P-44-7'}))
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.tag IS NOT NULL | n.tag] AS path_tags

MATCH p = shortestPath(
  (a:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'TK-9-1'})-[:send_to|continues_as*..100]->(b:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'T-31-2'})
)
WITH [n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.tag IS NOT NULL] AS items
UNWIND items AS it
WITH items, it, range(0, size(items)-1) AS idx
RETURN it.tag AS tag, labels(it)[0] AS item_class, idx[apoc.convert.toInteger(0)] AS dummy
ORDER BY dummy
MATCH (n {tag: 'CHV-11-2'}) RETURN n.tag AS tag, labels(n) AS labels

MATCH (v:Vessel {tag:'V-30-2'})<-[r:send_to]-(valve:OperatedValve)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:send_to]->(valve2:OperatedValve)
WITH collect(DISTINCT valve)+collect(valve2) AS valves
UNWIND valves AS vl
MATCH (f:ProcessInstrumentationFunction)-[:control]->(vl)
RETURN DISTINCT vl.tag AS valve_tag, f.tag AS loop_tag

MATCH (t:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'T-13-2'})-[:send_to|send_to]-(v:OperatedValve)
MATCH (i:ProcessInstrumentationFunction)-[:control]->(v)
RETURN DISTINCT coalesce(i.loop_tag, i.tag) AS control_loop, v.tag AS valve

MATCH (a)-[:control|send_signal_to]->(v:Valve)
WHERE a.loop_tag = 'TIC-27-1'
RETURN v.tag AS valve_tag

MATCH (i:ProcessInstrumentationFunction {tag: 'TIC-44-3'})-[:measured_by]-(e:Equipment)
RETURN DISTINCT e.tag AS equipment_tag

MATCH (v:Equipment {tag: 'V-15-1'})
MATCH (v)-[:send_to]->(n)
WHERE (n:Equipment OR n:OperatedValve OR n:PipingComponent)
  AND NOT n:OffPageConnector
RETURN DISTINCT n.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag;

MATCH (start:Equipment {tag:'TK-14-5'}), (end:Equipment {tag:'TK-9-2'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((start)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..100]->(end))
WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE none(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['SignalOffPageConnector','FlowInSignalOffPageConnector','FlowOutSignalOffPageConnector']))
WITH [n IN nodes(p) WHERE NOT n:PipeOffPageConnector AND NOT n:FlowInPipeOffPageConnector AND NOT n:FlowOutPipeOffPageConnector] AS items
RETURN [n IN items | coalesce(n.tag, n.piping_component_name)] AS flow_path
ORDER BY size(flow_path) ASC
LIMIT 1

MATCH path = (start:Equipment {tag:'E-10-3'})-[:send_to|continues_as*]->(end:Equipment {tag:'T-15-5'})
WITH [n IN nodes(path) WHERE (n:Equipment OR n:OperatedValve OR n:BallValve OR n:GlobeValve OR n:CheckValve) | n.tag] AS tags
RETURN tags

MATCH (a:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'TK-14-4'})-[:is_located_in]->(ua:PlantSection),
      (b:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'E-14-1'})-[:is_located_in]->(ub:PlantSection)
RETURN a.tag, ua.unit_id, b.tag, ub.unit_id, ua = ub AS same_unit

MATCH (t:TaggedPlantItem {tag: 'T-49-1'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:same_tagged_item_as*0..1]-(item)
MATCH (item)-[:is_drawn_on]->(s:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT s.sheet_id AS sheet_id, item.tag AS tag

MATCH (t:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'T-35-3'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:same_tagged_item_as]->(main)
WITH t, collect(main) AS mains
UNWIND ([t] + mains) AS n
MATCH (n)-[:is_drawn_on]->(s:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT n.tag AS tag, s.sheet_id AS sheet_id

MATCH (start:Tank {tag:'T-23-4'}), (end:Tank {tag:'T-3-9'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((start)-[:send_to|continues_as*..150]->(end))
WITH [n IN nodes(p) WHERE (n:Equipment OR n:PipingComponent) AND n.tag IS NOT NULL] AS items
WITH [i IN range(0, size(items)-1) WHERE i = 0 OR items[i].tag <> items[i-1].tag | items[i].tag] AS path
RETURN path AS flow_path_from_T_23_4_to_T_3_9

MATCH path = shortestPath((a:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'TK-49-5'})-[:send_to|continues_as*]->(b:TaggedPlantItem {tag:'T-18-4'}))
UNWIND nodes(path) AS n
WITH [x IN nodes(path) WHERE x.tag IS NOT NULL] AS items
RETURN items

MATCH (pump:CentrifugalPump {tag:'P-25-2'})
MATCH (v) WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve) AND NOT v:CheckValve
MATCH (v)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..100]->(pump)
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve

MATCH (p:CentrifugalPump {tag:'P-3-1'})
MATCH (v)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..]->(p)
WHERE (v:BallValve OR v:GlobeValve OR v:OperatedValve)
RETURN DISTINCT v.tag AS valve_to_close

MATCH (target:Equipment {tag:'V-2-3'})
MATCH (src)
WHERE (src:Equipment OR src:PipingComponent OR src:ProcessInstrumentationFunction)
  AND NOT ( ()-[:send_to]->(src) )
MATCH p = shortestPath( (src)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..50]->(target) )
RETURN DISTINCT src.tag AS source_tag
ORDER BY source_tag

MATCH (target {tag: 'P-3-6'})
MATCH (src)
WHERE src.tag IS NOT NULL AND src <> target
  AND NOT ()-[:send_to]->(src)
MATCH p = shortestPath((src)-[:send_to|continues_as*1..]->(target))
RETURN DISTINCT src.tag AS source_tag
